items.english: Close the birds in every night.
items.backtranslation: Close the chickens in one by one at night.
items.problem: 'Every night' became 'one by one'; the predator-safety rule (shut in nightly) is not stated.

items.english: ... so beekeepers here do not normally treat for it.
items.draft: ... ngoko abagcini beenyosi apha abahlali beyinyanga.
items.backtranslation: ... so beekeepers here do not stay with the month (unintelligible).
items.problem: Clause is garbled; the fact that beekeepers do not normally treat for varroa is lost.
items.corrected: ... ngoko abagcini beenyosi apha ngokuqhelekileyo abayinyangi.

items.english: Commercial hybrids ... produce more but need good feed and care
items.problem: Passive 'are produced' instead of 'produce more'; the benefit of hybrids is misstated.

items.english: light enough for two people to drag
items.problem: Typo (words run together) in 'two people'. Minor.
